name: Benjamin Netanyahu
role: Prime minister (caretaker after the 10/27/2026 election), Likud leader
wants: Stay prime minister, or decide who follows him (inferred from his record of leading every government since 2009 except 2021 to 2022; see record).
A coalition built on his own bloc, which won more seats than the opposition bloc on 10/27/2026 but not a majority (fc-il-netanyahu-bloc-more-seats, fc-il-any-bloc-61-seats).
Keep the war footing against Iran that began 02/28/2026 (tl-2026-02-28-iran-war) as the frame of Israeli politics (inferred).
fears: A government sworn in without Likud, which ends his term the day it wins a confidence vote (ev-il-knesset-61).
Losing control of his own bloc: partners who sit with the mandate holder instead of him (inferred).
His corruption trial, which continues while he is in office (reported; verify the current status before using it).
constraints: No bloc reached 61 seats on 10/27/2026, so he cannot form a government alone (fc-il-any-bloc-61-seats).
The first mandate to form a government is reported to have gone to Gadi Eisenkot; Polymarket priced that at 98% on 11/07/2026 (reported; confirm with the President's Residence).
A caretaker government has narrower room on long-term commitments, by custom and court rulings (stated; verify the current attorney general guidance).
The Haredi conscription dispute split his last coalition from May 2026 (ev-il-haredi-draft-crisis).
red_lines: Sitting as a junior partner under Eisenkot (inferred; no public statement found, treat as open).
who_can_remove_them: The Knesset, by expressing confidence in a new government with 61 votes (ev-il-knesset-61).
His bloc partners, by backing another candidate for prime minister (inferred).
A court verdict in his trial, which would start a legal fight over incapacity (reported; verify).
tells: Likud members in the Hebrew press on whether they would sit with Eisenkot.
Coalition-agreement leaks and ministry demands in Hebrew outlets and Amit Segal's Telegram channel.

record.what: Israel joins the US strikes on Iran (Operation Roaring Lion); state of emergency, 20,000 reservists called up
Knesset dissolves after months of coalition crises over Haredi conscription
Election: his bloc wins more seats than the opposition bloc, no bloc reaches 61, Likud does not land in the 20 to 24 seat band

open_questions: Would he sit under Eisenkot, or let Likud split to do it?
